SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch, S. 2.
REPORT
Date. April 11, 1935.
File No. D
Subject. Miss A. N. Sotnikov.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached letter dated March 13,
1935, Tientsin, from Mr. F. A. Pavlov regarding the where-
abouts of Miss A. N. Sotnikov, enquiries show that Agnia
Nikolaevna Sotnikov is a Russian who was born in 1899 at
Blagoveshensk, Amur Province. Her late father was an
officer of an Amur Cossacks' Regiment, who was later employed
with the Siberian Railway. A. N. Sotnikov was educated
at Prince Oldenburg's Institute in Petrograd. Having
graduated in 1918, she returned to Blagoveshensk. In 1919
she arrived at Harbin where she resided with her sister,
Mrs. E. N. Ushkevitch, a teacher by occupation, until 1929,
when she left for Tientsin. In Tientsin she cohabited
for about four years with one Guezennec, Inspector of the
French Municipal Police. In June 1934 Miss Sotnikov
arrived at Shanghai from Tientsin. Here she was employed
as a waitress at the "Caveau Pigale," No. 372 Avenue du Roi
Albert, for three months and subsequently at the "Mulin Rouge,"
Rue Brenier de Montmorand, for about four months. At present
Miss Sotnikov is unemployed and cohabits with one N. N.
Gleboff, unemployed musician.
She resides at House 4, Passage 256, Avenue Dubail.
She is not registered with the Public Safety Bureau
or Russian Emigrants' Committee or Council of United Public
Organizations at Shanghai (Soro).
Nothing detrimental is known by this office against
this individual.

[Signature]
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Br.)

（左侧手写批注：）
S2,

[Signature]

（底部手写签名：）
D.S. Tcheremshansky [Signature] 11/4/35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处，S. 2。
报告
日期：1935年4月11日。
档案编号 D
主题：A. N. 索特尼科娃小姐。
制作人 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 转呈人 [签名]

关于附呈的1935年3月13日来自天津F. A. 帕夫洛夫先生询问A. N. 索特尼科娃小姐下落的信件，经查，阿格尼娅·尼古拉耶芙娜·索特尼科娃（Agnia Nikolaevna Sotnikov）系俄罗斯人，1899年生于阿穆尔省布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveshensk）。其已故父亲曾任阿穆尔哥萨克团军官，后受雇于西伯利亚铁路。A. N. 索特尼科娃曾在彼得格勒奥尔登堡亲王学院（Prince Oldenburg's Institute）受教育。1918年毕业后，她返回布拉戈维申斯克。1919年抵达哈尔滨，与其姐E. N. 乌什克维奇夫人（Mrs. E. N. Ushkevitch，职业为教师）同住，直至1929年前往天津。在天津期间，她与法国公董局警务处督察盖泽内克（Guezennec）同居约四年。1934年6月，索特尼科娃小姐从天津抵达上海。在此地，她先是在阿尔伯特国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）372号的“Caveau Pigale”担任女服务员三个月，随后在蒙莫朗德布雷尼耶路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）的“Mulin Rouge”工作约四个月。目前索特尼科娃小姐失业，与失业音乐家N. N. 格列博夫（N. N. Gleboff）同居。
她居住在杜拜尔路（Avenue Dubail）256弄4号。
她未在上海公安局、俄国侨民委员会或上海各公共团体联合会（Soro）登记。
本处未发现对该人不利的记录。

[签名]
D. S.
副警务总监（特别处）

（左侧手写批注：）
S2，
请
告知A.
索特尼科娃
小姐，我们已
收到来自
天津的
来函，并
询问她是否
希望将其
地址列入
我处的
社区索引中。
[签名]

（底部手写签名：）
D.S. 切列姆尚斯基 [签名] 1935年4月11日

P. A. Pavlov
Cousins road
Pao-shan-li 32
Tientsin

March 13, 1935
Cousins road
Pao-shan-li 32.
Tientsin
Dear Sir,
I shall be much obliged for some
information concerning Sonia W-
slaivna. Sotnikov. Her whereabout,
occupation and address. She is 36
years old. Last year she left Tientsin
for Shanghai and we heard nothing
about her since that time.
An early reply will oblige
Yours truly P. A. Pavlov
pages.zh:
P. A. 帕夫洛夫
库辛斯路
宝山里32号
天津

1935年3月13日
库辛斯路
宝山里32号。
天津
尊敬的先生：
如蒙提供有关索尼娅·弗拉基米罗芙娜·索特尼科娃（Sonia W-lslaivna. Sotnikov）的一些信息，我将不胜感激。包括她的下落、职业和地址。她今年36岁。去年她离开天津前往上海，此后我们便杳无音讯。
早日回复将不胜感激
此致 P. A. 帕夫洛夫
